_about: Sound registry. "buses" is the mixer: AudioMix (scripts/audio/audio_mix.gd) builds these buses at start and each one gets a volume slider under Settings > Audio (the setting key is audio.<bus id>). "entries" are sounds, one each (lane B4 fills them): {"files": ["res://assets/audio/..."], "bus": "weapons", "volume_db": 0, "pitch_jitter": 0.05, "max_distance_m": 400, "attenuation": "inverse_square"}. Candidates under review live in assets/audio/review/ with its listening page.
